name: Review slip
description: A photocopied tick-box slip lists a book, a film and an album; the first two are ticked in red pen and the album is crossed out, above a dotted tear-off coupon.
choices: The swap-letter form becomes a media review card: one box per thing you read, watched or heard
Photocopier black on warm white, red pen marks, grain and a toner streak; no typed words are needed
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
